tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i srog dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru kā la kro dhā ya/ chos nyid mun pa'i mdangs 'dzin stong gsum gyi// ma rungs gzugs brnyan dbyings su za byed pa// thugs rje shin tu khros la gus btud nas// bka' yi gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs// mtshan nyid dang nus par ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis dam ldan khyad par du gyur pa'i slob ma re tsam la dbang chen drag po 'di nyid kyi srog dbang sbyin par 'dod na/ stegs bur maṇḍal gru gsum nag po me ris bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ nag pos mtshan pa bkod pa'i steng rkang gsum khar/ zangs lcags kyi snod du dpal gtor nag por rta mgo can 'khor brgyad dang mtheb skyus bskor ba sha khrag gi rgyan ldan sku rten dar nag gi gdugs phub pa bsham/ mdun du dar nag la bris pa'i sku rten dang lcags kyu/ g.yas su tsan dan ral gri /g.yon du seng ldeng phur bu/ rgyab tu srog 'khor rab gnas can dar nag gis dril ba rnams bzhag /gzhung don ltar na dar nag sku dang srog 'khor mda' dar la btags nas gtor ma la btsugs par gsungs kyang dbang rkyang tsam la lag len snga ma ltar stabs bde zhing phyag mtshan rnams kyang dngos ma 'byor na tsakli bkod/ rgyab ngos sman raka gtor gsum/ chu gnyis nyer spyod bskor bsham bya/ las bum/ gtor tshogs nyer mkho rnams tshogs par byas nas/ brgyud 'debs/ dkar gtor spyi ltar/ skyabs sems dang yan lag bdun pa gter gzhung ltar dang*/ bgegs bskrad nas mchod pa byin rlabs bar smin gling gter chen chog bsgrigs ltar bya/ de nas gter gzhung tshig lhug gi bdag bskyed dang bzlas pa ci 'grub/ slar de nyid mdun bskyed la kha spos nas/ spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i bar btang ba'am/ yang na gter chen gyis mdzad pa'i las byang ltar mngon rtogs nas bzlas pa la thug gi bar mdun bskyed du btang yang chog la/ snga ma ltar na/ rtsa sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis/ mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa skad cig gis gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por pad nyi'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin

zhes sogs nas/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rta mgrin nag po sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ hūm̐: chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: sogs nas bstod pa'i mthar thug pa'i bar sngar bshad ltar byas nas/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig mthing ga rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa zhal nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas thon mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas 'gal me ltar 'khor bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsam la rtsa sngags brgya stong sogs dang sham bu sbyar ba'ang ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ hūm̐: thugs rje chen po sogs kyis gtor ma 'bul la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang len nam rig pa'i me tog dor/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bskyed bzlas kyis byin brlab bo// slob ma gcig gam gsum las mi mang ba khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang nas bka' bsgo mtshams gcad bya/ maṇḍal bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de la 'dir rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo thugs rje'i rang gzugs gcig tu shar ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid gdul bya gdug pa can gyi ngor 'bar ba chen po'i skur bstan pa dbang chen rta mchog he ru ka ste/ de nyid mi srun pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po rnams kyi gnyen por slar yang drag tu khros pa dpal rta mgrin nag po la rgyud dang sgrub thabs kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa mchis pa las/

snyigs dus kyi rgyal bsen sa bdag klu gnyan ma rungs pa 'dul ba la lhag par bsngags shing gdams ngag gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa 'di nyid rta mchog nyid dang ngo bo gcig pa slob dpon chen po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyis/ dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu nag po klu 'dul gyi rgyud las phyungs te mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal dang mnga' bdag rgyal po gnyis la thugs kyi zungs su bstsal pa ste/ rdo rje'i gsung las/ bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rta mgrin dbang gi dngos grub brnyes: snang srid 'jig rten dbang du bsdus: lha srin sde brgyad bran du khol: phrin las gang bcol thogs pa med: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru gyur: de phyir dbang chen rta mgrin gyi: sgrub thabs bye ba sa ya brtsams: la la mchog gi don la dgongs: la la dregs pa gcun la dgongs: la la dgra bgegs 'dul la dgongs: 'di ni dgongs pa gcig tu dril: de dag kun gyi snying po yin: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags dang: drag sngags kun gyi rno so yin: bya sla tshegs chung don chen 'di: rjes 'jug don du zab par gdams: zhes dang*/ ma hā kā la rta gdong can: thugs rje mtshungs med bla ma yin: byin rlabs myur mdzad yi dam yin: bstan pa srung phyir chos skyong yin: dgra bgegs sgrol phyir las mkhan yin: 'di la rgyas bsdus 'ga' yod kyang: dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa 'di: 'khor gyi rnam grangs nges med phyir: bkra shis rgyud ni 'jam pa yin: gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: rang bzhin shugs kyis 'khor ba'i phyir: shin tu rno la myur ba yin: zhes bsngags pa don dang ldan pa'i zab chos 'di nyid snyigs dus gdul bya'i don tu bsam yas mchims phu'i tshogs khang dbus kyi ka ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod du sbas pa/ mnga' bdag skye ba bcu gsum pa zab gter shing rta'i srol 'byed nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa 'di'i smin byed thun mong byin rlabs kyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa srog dbang shin tu gnyan pa gnyis su yod pa las da lam srog dbang zab mo bsgrub pa yin pas/ thog mar zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug / bla ma dang rta mgrin nag po dbyer ma mchis pa la gus pa chen pos thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dang gnyis med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: bcug nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lan gsum/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo rang rig byang chub sems dang bla ma rta mgrin dbang chen dbyer med pa la byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ gzhan don byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de de'i spyad pa spyod par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku: byang chub sems la skyabs su mchi: dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs nas: bstan dang 'gro ba'i don slad du: bsnyen cing bsgrub par dam bca' 'o: lan gsum/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du srin lag gis bdud rtsi'i thig le bkod la/ khyed rang gi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa: mgrin par padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa: snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa: rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gsal thob cig /de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs sprin gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdun rnam par dag pa bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa'i tshogs rnams mthol lo bshags: rang gzhan dge la rjes yi rang: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: dge ba 'gro kun yongs la bsngo: lan gsum/

rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa rnams blangs nas tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma dpal chen he ru ka: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sngon tshe rgyal bas thugs bskyed ltar: byang chub sems ni bzung bar bgyi: sangs rgyas rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: rdo rje'i rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: rin chen rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: padma'i rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: las kyi rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: lan gsum brjod/ de nas dbang bskur dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs kyis: sku yi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lan gsum/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: rtsa sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: drag po'i spyan gsum bgrad cing: smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa: zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba: mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa: phyag g.yas sgrol byed kyi ral gris dgra bgegs kyi mgo lus dum bur gtubs pa: g.yon pas 'dzin byed kyi lcags kyus dgra bgegs kyi srog snying 'dren pa: zhabs gnyis dor thabs kyis dgra bgegs non par gnon pa: sku la dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba: spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad drag po nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas: khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud cing srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon pa: sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang:

sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba: thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa: ba spu'i gseb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: bskal pa'i me phung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i skur lam gyis gyur par mos shig: de ltar khyed rang dam tshig par gsal ba la/ mdun bskyed kyi khro bo'i sku gsung thugs las: khro bo dkar dmar mthing gsum nas 'bras tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa ye shes pa'i ngo bor bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin byung nas: slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga nas thim pas: lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad sang sang dag: rgyud byin gyis brlab par mos mdzod/ dar nag sku spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: dar nag sku yi dbang bskur bas: snang srid zil gyis non par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: des sku yi dbang thob: dpal rta mgrin bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs kyis: gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags phreng ā li kā li dang bcas pa dmar na ra ra byung ba: slob ma'i mgrin par thim pas lus thams cad sngags kyis dmar ltem me gang nas: drag sngags la nus pa thon par mos shig: lcags kyu mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: lcags kyu gsung gi dbang bskur bas: log 'dren dbang du sdud par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: des gsung gi dbang thob: drag po'i sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/

yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs kyis: thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gzi brjid dang ldan pa: 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byung nas: slob ma'i snying khar thim pas lus thams cad hūm̐ sngon pos gang nas: rtogs pa 'char zhing nus pa dang ldan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: phur pa snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: phur pa thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: dregs pa las la 'khol bar shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des thugs kyi dbang thob: rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs kyis: yon tan sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha la myur ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang ste: ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dregs pa pho mo rnams kyi srog snying mthu nus thams cad dbang du bsdus nas: slar 'dus te khro bo'i thugs kar thim pas: khro bo'i thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i 'od kyi thig le sngon po gcig tu gyur: de slob ma'i lte bar thim pas rta mgrin gyi srog dbang thob pas khams gsum gyi dregs pa sde brgyad ma lus pa'i srog la dbang sgyur bar mos shig: srog 'khor lte bar bzhag la/ hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: yon tan tsakra'i dbang bskur bas:

khro bo'i mthu rtsal drag po'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐: des yon tan gyi dbang thob: ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal kha phyogs med du skyong ba la dbang*/ yon tan mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs kyis: phrin las sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi dbu skra bsigs pa'i skra gseb nas khro chu ljang nag dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: slob ma drag po mngon spyod kyi las la mnga' gsol bar mos shig: ral gri gsang bar bzhag cing lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: phrin las ral gri'i dbang bskur bas: dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: des phrin las kyi dbang thob: drag po mngon spyod gtso bor gyur pa'i phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub pa la dbang*/ phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no//

dpal gtor thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin nag po'i skur gsal ba/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas dpal khro bo rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad slob ma'i lus la zhugs par mos shig: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: ba liṃ gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas: longs spyod mthun rkyen 'phel bar shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'dir spro na bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan thams cad brjod la bka' bsgo spyi ltar bya zhing gtor ma mgor bzhag /mthar lag tu gtad la/ rdo rje'i slob ma khyod la dpal rta mgrin nag po'i srog dbang bskur pa yin pas: rta mgrin nag po 'di yi dam gyi lhar zungs shig: chongs shig: sgoms shig: sgrubs shig: thon cig: lha ma srin sde brgyad dang dregs pa can dbang du sdus shig: dam la thogs shig: dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar chod cig: ces brjod/ des rta mgrin nag po'i srog dbang shin tu gnyan pa thob pa yin pas 'di yi dam gyi lhar bzung ba dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i bran du 'bul zhing bka'i zur tsam yang mi nyams pa byed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar dang*/ deng nas brtsam ste sogs brjod/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ dge bsngo spyi 'gre bya/ slob dpon gyis gter srung gtor 'bul/ tshogs byin rlabs nas brtsam shis brjod kyi bar gyi rjes rim rnams gter chen gyis mdzad pa'i las byang ltar byas pas 'grub bo// lto tshol nus pa'i grags 'dod srog gi dbang*// gdon can khyim par bskur ba'i las ngan las// bzlog ste nyams len nus pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// 'phrad nas snyigs ma'i gdug pa 'joms byed shog /'di la chog khrigs kyi yig cha rnying pa kha shas 'dug kyang lung rgyun mi bzhugs pa dang kha cig tshig mang bar snang bas gter gzhung dngos la gsal byed phran bus brgyan te zab gter mdzod chen gyi bcud du padma gar dbang bstan gnyis gling pas tsa 'dra rin chen brag tu bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel//
